original_requirement: Implement and offline-validate a deterministic source-faithful selective-verbatim Skill compiler in shadow only, with five demand scenarios, exact provenance, fail-closed budget handling, and byte-identical production Prompt/model input.
closed_world_justification: The implementation is limited to one checked-in index containing exactly 11 Short Skills and 413 exact sections, one Planning/Event Realization stage/substage, five enumerated demand classes, one explicit selector/render/budget/provenance policy family, five sealed fixtures, and a disabled-by-default observer seam. Production cutover and model execution are excluded.
operational_definition: Validate the exact section index against current repo Skill bytes, select stage-owned reference sections from the existing resolver's four Planning Skill identities using only local hashed facts, close dependencies, render bodies verbatim with neutral delimiters, enforce a conservative semantic token budget without summarization or truncation, emit reconstructible hash-only receipts, and prove observer off/on/failure leaves the production gateway call tuple identical.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not treat the Selective Compiler as a predetermined mandatory architecture; full verbatim remains allowed when capacity, safety, duplication, and stage ownership all pass.
Do not paraphrase, summarize, substring-truncate, or silently drop mandatory/dependency sections.
Do not inspect generated prose, prior quality outcomes, Provider responses, randomness, credentials, or hidden reasoning.
Do not use shadow output for production Prompt, model input, validator, authority, route, retry, fallback, or budget decisions.
Do not classify the old Climax substring false-positive silently; bind the one exact shared-core exception.
Do not update historical sealed expectations to hide current-source or HEAD drift.
